original.target_description: Study 1: ethical versus unethical autobiographical recall; university participants; perceived room brightness on a 7-point scale; independent-samples t test.

n.sample_role: Participants in the Study 1 independent-samples comparison; total across ethical and unethical conditions.
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; total of 40 participants and t(38) support use of the full stated sample. Condition-specific sample sizes are not printed.
n.quote: Forty participants at a large public university participated in this study in return for partial course credit.

replication.target_description: The identified 2014 primary replication article contains four replication samples: Study 1 online and laboratory, and Study 2 online and laboratory. Study 1 has perceived-brightness tests for two distinct samples. Study 2 has estimated-watts and three product-preference tests for each of two samples. The supplied neutral description, null replication study identifier, and page-only locator do not uniquely identify a sample and test.

n.exclusions: Not established for an identified target test

reported_success.location: Author manuscript p. 9 (PDF p. 10 including repository cover), Discussion
reported_success.quote: Despite conducting high powered replication studies of BCS, we were unable to replicate the original effects in our own replication studies.

notes: Original Study 1 is uniquely identified by the explicit study identifier and neutral outcome description. It appears on published p. 407 (PDF p. 1). Replication locator p.3 is not unique in the supplied reference; no replication sample or study identifier is given. The cached replication source is the title- and DOI-matched accepted author manuscript, whose pagination differs from the published seven-page article. No mapping of the ten assigned IDs to the ten replication table effects was inferred from input order. The original Study 1/brightness description cannot justify assigning Study 2 product outcomes. Narrative failure verdict concerns the authors’ own replication attempts, not their broader meta-analysis. OSF seqgd file-listing endpoint returned 404; the full replication article was independently acquired from an openly accessible repository PDF mirror. Values quoted secondarily in the replication table were not used to establish the original statistics.
